verified.kill_fact: Primary sources confirm the forward leg but correct two load-bearing inputs. (1) The gap the line left open is closable: Vera's own IR announced FDA alignment on the earlier ORIGIN 3 eGFR analysis on JUNE 2, 2026 (eGFR Q3-26, sBLA Q4-26, full approval 2027) — and the stock FELL 7.9% that day, $33.94 (6/1) to $31.26 (6/2). Today's $32.23 is +3.1% vs that true pre-catalyst base, so 0%-harvested is CONFIRMED and is in fact stronger than the line's $40.13 proxy implies. But it also reframes the de-rate: the -19.7% from pre-PDUFA $40.13 (7/6) to $32.23 is a round-trip of the approval pop back to the pre-alignment level, i.e. franchise repricing as the 6th approved IgAN drug (Fabhalta, Voyxact, Filspari, Tarpeyo already selling), not "the market discounting competition while the binary sits unpriced." A positive eGFR print converts accelerated to full approval — confirming a nod already granted — while an adverse print puts a live, already-approved franchise at withdrawal risk. That is negative convexity, and the line's bull case does not price it. (2) Cash is misstated in the conservative direction: $596.8M cash/marketable securities at 3/31/26 with ~$106.5M/qtr operating burn, not "~$300M net cash" — runway past the readout is CONFIRMED and then some, but EV is nearer ~$1.85-1.9B than $2.0B off the $2.31B market cap. Numerator provenance is clean: no preferred stack, no PIK, no external manager, no waterfall ahead of the common beyond a term facility, so the derived value would accrue to the equity. Score cut 7 to 6: G3 remains unmet (the ~$58 is a self-derived franchise build, not a disclosed unpriced figure), the milestone is quarter-dated and can slip to end-Q3/Q4, and the pulled-forward analysis trades eGFR-slope follow-up for speed — the very trade the tape voted against on 6/2.
verified.analysis: The fired leg (accelerated approval, 7/7/26) is correctly excluded; what remains is a genuinely forward, FDA-aligned, company-guided confirmatory eGFR readout inside ~8 weeks, and the stock has de-rated ~20% below its pre-PDUFA level rather than re-rating on the win — a 0%-harvested setup where the market is discounting IgAN competitive intensity while the binary that governs full approval sits unpriced. Numerator provenance is clean and does not gate the score: no preferred stack, no external manager, no waterfall ahead of the common, ~$300M net cash and runway past the readout, so the ~$58 favorable value is a straight risk-adjusted franchise build off a $2.0B EV rather than an inherited $78 target, and the equity is what would actually receive it. Held to 7 not 8 because the milestone is quarter-dated rather than day-dated and can slip to end-Q3 or into Q4, G3 is unmet (no disclosed unpriced figure — my upside is derived), a pulled-forward eGFR analysis trades statistical follow-up for speed and can be muddied by the acute-dip artifact, and an adverse print on an accelerated approval is one of the harsher -45%+ tails in biotech; gaps I did not close in budget are the exact date of the FDA-alignment announcement (so the confirmatory leg's base is proxied by the pre-PDUFA $40.13) and Q2 launch metrics, which print mid-August and are the next real information event.
